
## LunaNav Contribution Checklist

Please confirm the following before submitting this pull request:

- [ ] Frontend build passes (`npm run build`).
- [ ] Backend verification passes (`python scripts/verify_backend.py` from the backend directory).
- [ ] No API keys, passwords, or secrets have been committed.
- [ ] Real, mock, and planned features are clearly identified.
- [ ] Screenshots or demo evidence are attached.
- [ ] Files changed are within the contributor's assigned scope.
